분석 방법:
1. 각 저장소의 마지막 커밋 메시지 확인
2. 커밋 수
3. 주요 파일 목록 (README, COMPLETION, PHASE 등)
4. 진행률 추정 (0~100%)

저장소 위치:
- /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/core/
- /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/modules/
- /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/archived/
- /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/experiments/
- /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/tools/
- /data/data/com.termux/files/home/projects/

각 저장소마다:
- git log -1 --format="%s" (마지막 커밋 메시지)
- git rev-list --count HEAD (커밋 수)
- ls 루트 파일 중 PHASE, COMPLETION, STATUS, FINAL 포함 파일명

결과를 다음 형식으로 정리:
카테고리 | 프로젝트명 | 커밋수 | 마지막커밋요약 | 진행률% | 상태(완료/진행중/초기/실험)

진행률 기준:
- FINAL/COMPLETION/완료 키워드 → 90~100%
- Phase N (높은 숫자) → 60~80%
- Phase 1~2 또는 커밋 1~3개 → 10~30%
- 커밋 많고 활발 → 50~70%
- archived → 완료로 간주

모든 프로젝트를 빠짐없이 분석해서 반환하세요.

cat > /tmp/analyze_projects.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

analyze_repo() {
    local repo_path="$1"
    local category="$2"
    
    if [ ! -d "$repo_path/.git" ]; then
        return
    fi
    
    local project_name=$(basename "$repo_path")
    local commit_count=$(cd "$repo_path" && git rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    local last_commit=$(cd "$repo_path" && git log -1 --format="%s" 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
    local root_files=$(cd "$repo_path" && ls -1 | grep -iE 'PHASE|COMPLETION|STATUS|FINAL|README' | head -5 | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
    
    echo "$category|$project_name|$commit_count|$last_commit|$root_files"
}

# Core projects
echo "=== CORE PROJECTS ==="
for repo in /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/core/*; do
    [ -d "$repo" ] && analyze_repo "$repo" "core"
done

# Modules
echo "=== MODULES ===" >&2
for repo in /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/modules/*; do
    [ -d "$repo" ] && analyze_repo "$repo" "modules"
done

# Archived
echo "=== ARCHIVED ===" >&2
for repo in /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/archived/*; do
    [ -d "$repo" ] && analyze_repo "$repo" "archived"
done

# Experiments
echo "=== EXPERIMENTS ===" >&2
for repo in /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/experiments/*; do
    [ -d "$repo" ] && analyze_repo "$repo" "experiments"
done

# Tools
echo "=== TOOLS ===" >&2
for repo in /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/tools/*; do
    [ -d "$repo" ] && analyze_repo "$repo" "tools"
done

# Root projects
echo "=== ROOT PROJECTS ===" >&2
for repo in /data/data/com.termux/files/home/projects/*; do
    [ -d "$repo" ] && [ -d "$repo/.git" ] && analyze_repo "$repo" "root"
done
EOF

bash /tmp/analyze_projects.sh 2>/dev/null

#!/bin/bash

estimate_progress() {
    local commits=$1
    local last_commit="$2"
    local root_files="$3"
    
    local progress=0
    
    # 커밋 수 기반
    if [ "$commits" -ge 100 ]; then
        progress=70
    elif [ "$commits" -ge 50 ]; then
        progress=60
    elif [ "$commits" -ge 30 ]; then
        progress=50
    elif [ "$commits" -ge 20 ]; then
        progress=45
    elif [ "$commits" -ge 10 ]; then
        progress=35
    elif [ "$commits" -ge 5 ]; then
        progress=25
    elif [ "$commits" -ge 3 ]; then
        progress=15
    else
        progress=5
    fi
    
    # 마지막 커밋 메시지 분석
    if echo "$last_commit" | grep -iE 'complete|final|done|finished|100%|PASS' > /dev/null; then
        progress=95
    elif echo "$last_commit" | grep -iE 'phase[0-9]|phase [a-z0-9]' > /dev/null; then
        local phase=$(echo "$last_commit" | grep -oiE 'phase[0-9]+|phase [a-z0-9]' | head -1 | sed 's/[^0-9]//g')
        if [ -z "$phase" ]; then
            phase=$(echo "$last_commit" | grep -oiE 'phase [a-z]' | sed 's/phase //')
            if [ -z "$phase" ]; then
                progress=$((progress + 5))
            else
                case "$phase" in
                    [a-f]) progress=$((progress + 25)) ;;
                    [g-l]) progress=$((progress + 35)) ;;
                    [m-z]) progress=$((progress + 45)) ;;
                esac
            fi
        else
            if [ "$phase" -ge 10 ]; then
                progress=80
            elif [ "$phase" -ge 5 ]; then
                progress=60
            elif [ "$phase" -ge 3 ]; then
                progress=40
            else
                progress=25
            fi
        fi
    elif echo "$last_commit" | grep -iE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+|release|production|stable' > /dev/null; then
        progress=85
    fi
    
    # 파일명 분석
    if echo "$root_files" | grep -iE 'FINAL|COMPLETION' > /dev/null; then
        progress=90
    elif echo "$root_files" | grep -iE 'PHASE_[5-9]|PHASE_[1-9][0-9]' > /dev/null; then
        progress=75
    fi
    
    # 진행률 상한선
    if [ "$progress" -gt 100 ]; then
        progress=100
    fi
    
    echo "$progress"
}

# 결과 수집

cd /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.projects/core

for repo in */; do
    if [ -d "$repo/.git" ]; then
        project_name="${repo%/}"
        commits=$(git -C "$repo" rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
        last_commit=$(git -C "$repo" log -1 --format="%s" 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
        root_files=$(ls -1 "$repo" | grep -iE 'PHASE|COMPLETION|STATUS|FINAL|README' | head -5 | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
        
        progress=$(estimate_progress "$commits" "$last_commit" "$root_files")
        
        if [ "$progress" -lt 50 ]; then
            status="초기"

            status="진행중"
        else
            status="완료"
        fi
        
        echo "core|$project_name|$commits|$progress|$status|$last_commit"
    fi
done | head -20

EOF
